paper_title: Graph Neural Network Approach to Semantic Type Detection in Tables
caption: The macro f-score of GAIT_{GAT} and RECA on Semtab dataset, for High, Medium, and Low-frequency classes.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the macro f-score performance of two models, RECA and GAIT_{GAT}, on the Semtab dataset, categorized by frequency levels: High, Medium, and Low. The vertical axis represents the macro f-score, scaled linearly from 0 to 1 with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. The horizontal axis displays the three frequency categories in descending order: High, Medium, and Low. For each frequency category, two bars are shown side-by-side: the lighter peach-colored bar represents RECA, and the darker orange bar represents GAIT_{GAT}, as indicated by the legend below the chart. In the High-frequency category, RECA achieves a macro f-score of 0.837, while GAIT_{GAT} scores 0.877. In the Medium-frequency category, RECA scores 0.538 and GAIT_{GAT} scores 0.609. In the Low-frequency category, RECA scores 0.114 and GAIT_{GAT} scores 0.224. Across all frequency levels, GAIT_{GAT} consistently outperforms RECA, with the performance gap being most pronounced in the Low-frequency category. The bars are not sorted by height within each group but are grouped by frequency category, and each bar is labeled with its exact f-score value.
